finalText:
Everything runs clean until 02:14:07 on 2026-07-04. Then Redis, the fast lookup service at 10.0.0.12, drops with `ECONNREFUSED`. The app falls back to reading straight from the main store, which it wasn't built to handle at full load.

From there it's a slow death. Reconnects to Redis keep failing, once every 80 seconds, all the way to attempt 12 at 02:31:26, and every attempt fails the same way. Meanwhile the backup queue keeps growing, from 52 waiting jobs up past 500, and requests start timing out after 5 seconds because the main store can't keep up.

It ends at 02:31:44. One of the workers, `worker-2`, runs out of memory and dies. The supervisor restarts it, but eight seconds later the whole `api` service stops responding, and at 02:31:52 the service goes down for good.

So the real cause was Redis going unreachable at 02:14:07. Everything after that, the timeouts, the memory crash, the outage, was the app struggling for 17 minutes without it.
